claim: A lift may carry the player through a room-over-room plane: the car is the LOWER sector (type 600, ceiling 504) and stops 4,096 under the plane, and above it one sector of the same plan has a floor of 504. The player steps down onto it and looks down the shaft after it has gone.
evidence: E4M4 s159: type 600, ceiling 504 at -24,576, floor 8,192 to -20,480 (catalog record)
use: Copy this for a lift between two stacked layers; switches at the stops call it, since one on the car is not seen across the plane.
